title: Add `--include-descendants` to `glab milestone list --group`
description:
## Problem

`glab milestone list --group <group>` only returns milestones defined on that group. You can't list milestones from its subgroups or their projects. The command already has `--include-ancestors` for parent groups, but nothing for descendants.

## Proposal

Add an `--include-descendants` flag that sets `include_descendants=true` on [List group milestones](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/group_milestones/#list-group-milestones).

- The flag applies only with `--group`. Reject it with `--project`.
- Show the owning group or project in the output, because results now span namespaces.

## Context

client-go only started sending `include_descendants` in v3.40.1 ([client-go!3164](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/api/client-go/-/merge_requests/3164), which also decodes `project_id` on group milestones). glab picks this up in https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/merge_requests/4273, so this issue depends on that MR being merged.

Relevant code: `internal/commands/milestone/list/list.go`.
